answer: Reputation accrues only through verified interactions, forming a trellis of sparse historical edges; each edge adds weight bounded by a concave function, so forging k identities yields linear cost against sublinear trust gain, an unfavorable tradeoff. Idle decay applies an exponential discount to weight, pricing patience above the attacker's budget. A sybil swarm must therefore sustain saffron-valued spend continuously to hold rank, and any lapse erodes it toward the canyon floor where privileges vanish. The mechanism trades honest slow ramp-up for a hard economic barrier.
